title: Write an email to Kevin
description: Prepare a Jira project status email as a Gmail draft for review.

context.objective: Prepare a project update email for Kevin.
constraints: Create a draft only. Do not send it.
Resolve recipient and project before acting; do not invent unavailable information.
context.notes: All references are synthetic; Kevin and the project must be resolved in a real task.

criteria.description: Draft contains status, deadline, risks and comment summary.
The draft remains unsent and its reference and source evidence are recorded.

execution_guidance.prompt: Research the specified Jira project and create a Gmail draft for Kevin, for user review.
steps: Read project status and relevant Jira issues.
Check the deadline and documented delivery risks.
Summarize relevant recent comments with source references.
Compose and save a Gmail draft to the resolved recipient. Do not send.
Record the draft reference and evidence in Movement.
required_capabilities: Read the specified Jira project and comments

expected_outputs.description: Unsent Gmail project update draft for Kevin.

completion_check.prompt: Read the draft referenced by the latest work report. Verify the intended recipient, status/deadline/comment summary, and unsent state. Report unknown if access or evidence is missing. Do not send.
